title: Flow Cytometry Analysis of Human Neutrophil Extracellular Traps in vitro
author: Haruchika Masuda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3zzgp76

steps.title: Obtain ethical approval
steps.instruction: Secure institutional approval and follow the Clinical Investigation Committee guidelines for experiments using human neutrophils.

steps.title: Collect peripheral blood
steps.instruction: Aspirate 10–15 mL of peripheral blood from healthy volunteers into a 20 mL heparinized syringe, obtaining written or verbal consent.

steps.title: Layer blood and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Lay 15 mL of aspirated blood over an equal volume of PolymorphoPrep™ density‑gradient medium (#1114683; PROGEN Biotechnik GmbH) in a 50 mL conical tube, centrifuge at 480 ×g, 20 °C for 30 min, aspirate the upper mononuclear layer, and transfer the lower neutrophil layer to a 15 mL conical tube containing 10 mL Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBSS) (#085-09355; FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical).

steps.title: Lyse erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the transferred cells at 400 ×g, 20 °C for 20 min, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL diluted BD Pharm Lyse™ lysing buffer (10×) prepared with sterile distilled water, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Harvest neutrophils
steps.instruction: Make the volume up to 15 mL with PBS‑2 mM EDTA, then centrifuge at 300 ×g, 4 °C for 10 min; discard supernatant and suspend the pellet in 2 mL of 1 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (FBS) in RPMI‑1640 (#187-02021; FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical) containing penicillin–streptomycin antibiotics (#P4333; Sigma‑Aldrich) at a 1:100 ratio.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the neutrophil suspension through a 35 µm nylon mesh cell‑strainer cap filter (#352235; Corning) attached to a 5 mL polystyrene round‑bottom tube.

steps.title: Confirm neutrophil identity
steps.instruction: Verify the cell population by flow cytometry for high expression of CD16, CD11b, and CD66b.

steps.title: Prepare conditioned media
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 % (v/v) FBS/RPMI‑1640 medium containing human fibrinogen (hFgn) 2 mg/mL (#F4883; Sigma‑Aldrich), recombinant human TNF‑α 100 ng/mL (#AF-300-01A; PeproTech), and optionally DF‑521 0.4 BU/mL (Tobishi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.).

steps.title: Plate conditioned media
steps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL of each conditioned medium into each well of a 24‑well suspension plate (#662102; Greiner).

steps.title: Seed neutrophils
steps.instruction: Adjust isolated neutrophils to 1 × 10⁶ cells per 500 µL of 1 % FBS/RPMI‑1640, add 500 µL to each well containing the conditioned medium.

steps.title: Incubate neutrophils
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37 °C in a 5 % CO₂ incubator for 4 h.

steps.title: Collect non‑adherent cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the conditioned medium containing non‑adherent neutrophils into 15 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Collect adherent cells
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL PBS‑2 mM EDTA to each well, pipette to detach cells, collect the suspension into the same tubes, and repeat the PBS wash twice more for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Centrifuge harvested cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined cell suspensions at 220 ×g, 4 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in flow buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 200 µL flow cytometry buffer (PBS‑2 mM EDTA with 0.1 % v/v FBS).

steps.title: Filter before staining
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a new 35 µm nylon mesh placed on a 1.5 mL capless graduated microcentrifuge tube (#NC-509-GRD-Q; Quality Scientific Plastics).

steps.title: Block monocytes
steps.instruction: Divide the suspension into two 100 µL aliquots and add 2 µL True Stain Monocyte Blocker™ (#426101; BioLegend) to each.

steps.title: Stain for MPO
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL mouse anti‑human MPO‑FITC antibody (#ab11729; Abcam, clone 2C7) or isotype control mouse IgG1k‑FITC (#555909; BD Biosciences, clone MOPC‑21) to each 100 µL aliquot, incubate at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Wash each aliquot twice with 800 µL flow cytometry buffer by centrifugation at 800 ×g, 4 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Resuspend for DNA stain
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in 200 µL flow cytometry buffer.

steps.title: Add Sytox Orange
steps.instruction: Add Sytox™ Orange (#S-11368; Molecular Probes) to a final concentration of 5 µM, incubate at room temperature for 5 min to label extracellular DNA.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run the samples on a BD FACSVerse™ flow cytometer (Becton Dickinson).

steps.title: Analyze data
steps.instruction: Analyze the acquired data using FlowJo™ software version 10.4.1 (Tomy Digital Biology CO., Ltd.).

steps.title: Perform biological replicates
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire assay with neutrophils from at least three different volunteers to obtain experimental replicates.
